services.title: Carpentry
services.description: Framing, decking, custom joinery, cabinetry, and structural timber work. Built to Australian standards with timber that lasts — including heritage-sympathetic work on period homes.

services.title: Plastering
services.description: Flawless patching, full room sets, detailed cornice work, and render prep. Smooth finishes ready for paint, with proper heritage fibrous plaster restoration when required.

services.title: Renovations
services.description: Kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas. From full gut-and-rebuilds to targeted updates — including sensitive period home renovation across Taradale and the Mount Alexander Shire.

services.title: Extensions
services.description: Single and double-storey additions, garage conversions, and granny flats. Fully council-compliant builds matched to your existing home — heritage and modern alike.

services.title: Tiny House Building
services.description: Custom-built tiny homes on wheels or slab — off-grid capable, properly insulated for central Victoria winters, and fully finished to a residential standard.
